identificationModule.officialTitle: Adoptive Immunotherapy for Hematological Malignancy With Novel CAR-T Cells.

descriptionModule.detailedDescription: The Novel CAR-T contains either a scFv plus a PD-L1 blocker, or two scFvs, in a cytokine complex based outer memberane structure, this kind of structure enables the CAR-T cells to simultaneously target one or two targets on the tumor cell surface and enhance CAR-T cell persistence in tumor microenvironment，as well as stimulating innate T/NK cell activation and expansion.
